texts.at-0003: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid input by raising ledgerly.errors.BillingError with a snake_case code such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" or "negative_amount" and a string detail.

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic, as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py` does.

candidate.title: Compute periods like current_period
candidate.content: Billing period math lives in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py:current_period`: build `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and use floor division `(at - start) // length` against `ensure_utc(sub.started_at)`; reuse this pattern for renewal calculations.
